t0b_scan.method: 36-item curated working set (T3's four scene systems + B-roll wrappers + T4 furniture), not full 383 catalog. Real headless-DOM measurement: root/host forced to 1080x1920, all descendant elements checked via getBoundingClientRect() for off-canvas extent and scrollWidth/Height overflow (text clipping). Not a full render at seeked animation states -- raw initial DOM layout only (GSAP timelines are paused/unplayed). See wo/FVC-007/T0-GATE-A-REPORT.md for full analysis and caveats.
